name: The Swimsuit
description: Upon use, increases all allies' Elation by 24% for the next battle.
story:
"The Swimsuit" is a private submarine outfitted with a safe, cozy, and highly customizable cockpit. The truly elite never splash around at the beach. They prefer to dive beneath the waves in their own submarine, drinking in the sublime grandeur that only the most extreme environments can offer.

"When you have 'The Swimsuit,' who needs an actual swimsuit?"
